user.title: Swiss Meteo
user.description: Where should the forecast be for? Your Home Assistant location is pre-filled; move the marker for another place. The hourly forecast reads about 2 MB per model run (every hour); the daily forecast alone stays below 1 MB. Extended values add the temperature and precipitation uncertainty range, the cloud layers and the zero-degree level to the hourly forecast.

data.extended: Extended hourly values (uncertainty range, cloud layers, zero-degree level)
data.search: Place or postal code (optional; searching replaces the map location)
data.radar: Radar nowcast (rain now, nearest rain, rain in N minutes; about 8 MB a day)

place.title: Forecast point and weather station
place.description: The forecast points and SwissMetNet stations nearest to the location, nearest first. Pick the point that matches your place (a postal code centre, a mountain spot or a station) and the station whose live values suit you best — altitude and exposure matter more than distance. Without a station, the current values come from the forecast. The pollen station (the three nearest of the 15 MeteoSwiss stations) adds the hourly concentrations of birch, grasses, alder, hazel, beech, ash and oak and the MeteoSwiss load class.

search.title: Choose the place
search.description: The forecast points matching your search. The nearest stations are then offered around the chosen place.

abort.already_configured: This forecast point is already set up.

error.cannot_connect: The MeteoSwiss open data could not be read. Check the connection and try again.
error.no_match: No forecast point matches this text; try the postal code or another spelling.

init.title: Swiss Meteo settings
init.description: Switch the hourly forecast, the extended values or the official warnings on or off, or pick another weather station (the eight nearest to the forecast point are listed) or pollen station. Changing a setting reloads the entry; entity ids and history are kept.

data.extended: Extended hourly values (uncertainty range, cloud layers, zero-degree level)
data.radar: Radar nowcast (rain now, nearest rain, rain in N minutes; about 8 MB a day)

error.cannot_connect: The station list could not be read; the current station is kept.

rain_expected.name: Rain expected
rain_expected.description: Triggers when rain is forecast for one of the next six hours (at least 0.1 mm in an hour).

rain_cleared.name: Rain no longer expected
rain_cleared.description: Triggers when no rain is forecast for the next six hours any more.

frost_expected.name: Frost expected tonight
frost_expected.description: Triggers when the forecast drops to 0 °C or below before 09:00 the next morning.

new_forecast.name: New forecast run
new_forecast.description: Triggers when a new MeteoSwiss forecast run has been read (hourly).

warning_issued.name: Warning issued
warning_issued.description: Triggers when an official warning (MeteoSwiss via MeteoAlarm) comes into force for the forecast point.

warning_cleared.name: Warning cleared
warning_cleared.description: Triggers when no official warning is in force for the forecast point any more.

rain_starting.name: Rain approaching
rain_starting.description: Triggers when the radar shows rain reaching the forecast point within about 30 minutes, or rain has started there.

rain_started.name: Rain started
rain_started.description: Triggers when the radar shows rain at the forecast point.

rain_stopped.name: Rain stopped
rain_stopped.description: Triggers when the radar no longer shows rain at the forecast point.

is_rain_expected.name: Rain is expected
is_rain_expected.description: Tests if rain is forecast for one of the next six hours.

is_dry.name: No rain is expected
is_dry.description: Tests if no rain is forecast for the next six hours.

is_frost_expected.name: Frost is expected tonight
is_frost_expected.description: Tests if the forecast drops to 0 °C or below before 09:00 the next morning.

is_warning_active.name: A warning is in force
is_warning_active.description: Passes while an official warning (MeteoSwiss via MeteoAlarm) is in force for the forecast point.

is_raining.name: It is raining
is_raining.description: Passes while the radar shows rain at the forecast point.

is_not_raining.name: It is not raining
is_not_raining.description: Passes while the radar shows no rain at the forecast point.

is_rain_approaching.name: Rain is approaching
is_rain_approaching.description: Passes while the radar shows rain reaching the forecast point within about 30 minutes, or rain there.

import_history.name: Import station history
import_history.description: Reads the station's measurement archive from MeteoSwiss (hourly values since 1980, daily values since the station's start) and writes it into Home Assistant's long-term statistics: mean, minimum and maximum of the station sensors, plus precipitation, sunshine, evaporation and heating degree days as separate statistics (swiss_meteo:…). Run it once; running it again replaces the same period.

entry.name: Swiss Meteo entry
entry.description: The entry whose station is imported.

years.name: Years
years.description: How many years back, counted from the first of January of this year.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.description: Hourly values (about 7 MB per decade file) or daily values (one file for the whole history, about 2.5 MB).

values.name: Values
values.description: Which groups to import; empty means all.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Swiss Meteo entry is not loaded.

no_station.message: The entry has no weather station; the history import needs one (Configure dialog).

hourly_years.message: Hourly values are limited to 20 years per import; run the action again for earlier years, or choose daily values.
